content: The Conception Chart has its origins in 13th-century China. It is claimed to have the ability to predict the gender of a fetus conceived by an expectant couple. However, its accuracy has not been validated through the scientific method. In astrology, a Natal Chart represents the map of the sky at the exact date and time of an individual's birth. Using this Natal Chart, it is possible to derive a Conception Chart. The Conception Chart is essentially a map of the sky at the specific date and time when the individual was conceived. There are established methods to calculate the pregnancy period by analyzing the phase of the Moon, the Ascendant, and the Moon's position within the Natal Chart.
